image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference), lived-in face with subtle wisdom lines, warm brown shoulder-length hair loose. Sitting at a clean modern home desk with a laptop closed in background. She wears a soft cream linen short-sleeve shirt (suggests "I'm here to talk seriously about something").
She rests both hands on the desk in front of her, palms down, fingers gently spread - composed authoritative posture. Looks directly at camera with serious empathic expression.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical shot, eye level, subject distance 110cm.
Light: single soft window light from camera-right at 45°, color temperature 5200K (clean midday), subtle ambient bounce, professional but warm.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del 'parliamone seriamente'" - eyebrows neutral, mouth in slight calm smile (no teeth), eyes direct camera with patient educational energy, slight chin level. NOT smiling theatrically, NOT serious to the point of cold - patient teacher.
Aesthetic reference: Modern Italian science communicator/coach hybrid - Federica Fontana, Cristina Marino. NOT cinematic.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average proportions.
Color grading: neutral white balance + 3% warmth, professional but warm.
Composition: subject center frame, hands on desk visible mid-frame (composed authority), plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, golden hour, Sofia Coppola, dramatic, sad, model thin, instagram filter, makeup heavy, doctor coat, hospital, clinical setting, syringe visible, pill bottle visible
